question:
Find out the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

G_KPN_RPUXY_BE_PI_MP
solution:
Given : G_KPN_RPUXY_BE_PI_MP

By checking options :

 
• QJLDP → G__Q__KPN__J__RPUXY__L__BE__D__PI__P__MP → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• JPFLC → G__J__KPN__P__RPUXY__F__BE__L__PI__C__MP → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• JQPFL → G__**J**__KPN__**Q**__RPUXY__**P**__BE__**F**__PI__**L**__MP → (It follows the pattern of : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8ddd1a5079ea9767125adbbecaf6861d25db4c97d5fa85105ce5f114f0f5098.png] 
 
• QFDPA → G__Q__KPN__F__RPUXY__D__BE__P__PI__A__MP → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "**JQPFL**" is the correct answer.
